justification: Both are upright relief-carved slabs bearing profile creatures (including long-beaked bird-like heads) with a banded/registered layout and a horizontal row of repeated marks near the top, which is a generic correspondence any relief tradition might produce. B depicts human figures with elaborate headgear, hands, offerings and a dense field of small sign-like symbols, while A shows only schematic animals, a fringe band and rounded protomes at the top, with no human figures or script-like signs — the specific content differs almost entirely.
